title: Human Estimator's production-query implementation canonically lives in CG-AppBuilder-MCP, not a Human Estimator-local file
summary: estimator_get_knowledge_service_health and its five sibling production-query tools previously pointed at a file that never existed in CG-Human-Estimator-MCP. Fixed to resolve CG-AppBuilder-MCP/scripts/lib/estimating-knowledge/production-query.mjs via the same CG_APPBUILDER_MCP_ROOT / nested / sibling resolution pattern used by this repo's PromptOps and Application Bible gates. Committed 80a11671b5595ab579467e3630e8ad938932f107, not yet merged.
retrievalQuestions: Where does the real implementation of Human Estimator's production-query MCP tools actually live?
Why did estimator_get_knowledge_service_health fail with a module-not-found error before the fix?
What is the correct CG_APPBUILDER_MCP_ROOT resolution pattern for Human Estimator's knowledge client path?

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: A future agent sees a Human Estimator MCP production-query tool fail, or considers copying a knowledge-client module directly into CapitalGlass-BidComposer or CG-Human-Estimator-MCP
runPreflight: resolveHumanEstimatorClientPath() candidate resolution against the live repo layout
doNot: Copy CG-AppBuilder-MCP's production-query.mjs directly into Human Estimator or CapitalGlass-BidComposer to make a tool green -- this creates a divergent, un-owned duplicate
Assume the fix is deployed on the live shared checkout -- the commit is local and unmerged; the live server still runs the old broken code until it lands
proveBeforeClaiming: The fix is verified with CG_APPBUILDER_MCP_ROOT set explicitly when testing from an isolated worktree whose parent directory differs from the canonical /home/wesley/repos layout (see worktree-sibling-resolution-lesson-v1)
A real estimator_get_knowledge_service_health tools/call succeeds after the fix, not just a clean import
